source_name: District-wise, season-wise crop production statistics - Government of India, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (via data.gov.in)

non_rice_cropped_area_ha.definition: Sum of reported Area across every crop EXCEPT Rice, for that district, year and season. A measure of the non-rice agricultural footprint.

n_crops_grown.definition: Count of distinct crops with positive reported Area in that district, year and season. A crop-diversity measure.

n_rice_seasons.definition: Count of distinct seasons in which Rice is reported with positive area for that district and year. A district reporting rice in both Kharif and Rabi is double-cropping rice; this is a genuine cropping-intensity signal.

gross_cropped_area_ha.definition: Sum of reported Area across ALL crops including Rice, for that district, year and season.

rice_area_share.definition: Rice area divided by gross cropped area for that district, year and season.

note: Area units are hectares on the same evidence documented for this resource in data/raw/external/official_yield/andhra_pradesh/validation_report.md section 5. No state-level value is ever used as a district-level value: every row here is aggregated from district rows of the same resource.
